request: Build a small Jac web app with a sales dashboard: a line chart of daily revenue, a bar chart by category and summary tiles (total, average order, best day). Users filter by date range and category, and can hide a category from the legend, which also removes it from the totals. Keep the aggregation of orders into chart series in a tested module.
acceptance: Days in the range without orders appear as 0, not as missing points.
A range that starts after it ends is rejected; an empty result shows an empty state, not NaN averages.
Average order is revenue divided by order count, rounded to 2 decimals, and it changes when a category is hidden.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
